long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I will sit beside the telescope and wait for the light to change, and nobody needs to know why.
Those seeds from the Italian attic have been on my mind more than is reasonable, so I will read about them.
I will claim the lookout rock again, since I found it first.
From up high I can see everything arriving on the island before anyone else does.
I will keep a picture of the telescope, since I claimed it first.

today.reason: Eating was turned down because the bowl is empty until morning, so I will read, watch from high places and sit by the telescope instead, without going to the same place twice in a row.
